Privacy Policy


1. Introduction

Welcome to Weblify. We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you use our AI website generator platform.


2. Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

  • Personal information (name, email address, billing details)
  • Account login details
  • Website content you create using our platform
  • Usage data (browser type, device, IP address)
  • Cookies and tracking data


3. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

  • Provide and improve our services
  • Generate and manage your websites
  • Process payments and subscriptions
  • Offer customer support
  • Send important updates and notifications


4. Cookies & Tracking

Weblify uses cookies to enhance user experience, analyze traffic, and improve platform performance. You can disable cookies in your browser settings.


5. Data Protection

We implement security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure. However, no system is 100% secure.


6. Third-Party Services

We may use trusted third-party services for payment processing, analytics, or hosting. These providers follow strict data protection practices.


7. Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Access your personal data
  • Request corrections
  • Delete your account
  • Opt out of marketing emails


8. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Updates will be posted on this page.


9. Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at:

support@weblify.com

Security Policy


1. Our Commitment to Security

At Weblify, we prioritize the security and protection of our users’ data. We implement industry-standard security practices to safeguard information and ensure a secure platform experience.


2. Data Encryption

All sensitive data, including login credentials and billing information, is encrypted using secure protocols (SSL/TLS). This ensures that information transmitted between users and our servers remains protected.


3. Secure Infrastructure

Our platform is hosted on secure servers with advanced firewall protection, regular monitoring, and threat detection systems to prevent unauthorized access.


4. Access Control

Access to sensitive systems and user data is strictly limited to authorized personnel only. We follow role-based access control to minimize risk.


5. Regular Updates & Monitoring

We continuously monitor our systems for vulnerabilities and apply security patches and updates to maintain platform integrity and performance.


6. Payment Security

All payments are processed through trusted third-party payment gateways that follow strict security and compliance standards.


7. Account Protection

Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials. We recommend using strong passwords and enabling additional security measures when available.


8. Incident Response

In the event of a security issue, we take immediate action to investigate, mitigate risks, and notify affected users when necessary.


9. Reporting Security Issues

If you discover a vulnerability or security concern, please report it to:

security@weblify.com

Terms of Service


1. Acceptance of Terms

By accessing or using Weblify, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use our platform.


2. Description of Service

Weblify provides an AI-powered website generation platform that allows users to create, customize, and publish websites without coding.


3. User Accounts

To access certain features, you must create an account. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activities under your account.


4. Subscription & Payments

Some features require a paid subscription. By purchasing a plan, you agree to pay applicable fees. Subscription plans may renew automatically unless canceled before the billing date.


5. Acceptable Use

You agree not to:

  • Use the platform for unlawful purposes
  • Upload harmful, illegal, or copyrighted content without permission
  • Attempt to disrupt or compromise platform security


6. Intellectual Property

All platform content, software, branding, and technology belong to Weblify. Users retain ownership of the content they create using the platform.


7. Termination

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms without prior notice.


8. Limitation of Liability

Weblify is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our services.


9. Changes to Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use of the platform constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.


10. Contact Information

For questions regarding these Terms, contact us at:

support@weblify.com
